scope: independent design prototype only; no App implementation or repository mutation
supersedes: continuous-height drag as product positioning UI

units.comparisonComponents: magnification labeled on each board; not 100% desktop
units.preview100Percent: 1 source pixel per logical point; not physical pixel 1:1
units.prototypeApproximation: 500ms browser double-click proxy; exact native press/reflow/peek fade and magnet curve not frame-verified

geometry.effectiveCount: if F.height<200 then 0 else min(preference, floor((F.height-200)/60)+1)

line.zeroRightInset: draw stroke inside screen; keep occlusion plane at outer edge

geometry.distancePolicy: respect saved 0..256 including internal seam; only clamp effective geometry when needed for reachable input; never overwrite preference

appearance.numberPadWhen: exposed image width<24 or fitted height<20
appearance.microBorder: 1 physical pixel, light ink 18%, dark light 25%
appearance.inputIslands: actual visible image and visible number only; no invisible enlarged click rectangle

navigation.hiddenArrow: no active native input window or AX control
navigation.pageStep: effective capacity N with stable identity anchor
navigation.wheel: one group per native gesture; suppress momentum tail; browser approximates with quiet gap

viewport.order: preserve sort_at / sequence, oldest at top
viewport.ordinal: current visible queue rank + 1; frozen within interaction epoch
viewport.anchor: first surviving visible asset ID; never only page index
viewport.capacityChange: explicit user change recomputes chosen top/middle/bottom semantics after input boundary; preserve asset anchor unless entire remaining queue fits, then show all
viewport.refill: tombstone during protection; compact once at safe boundary
safeBoundary: pointer outside passive group envelope for 350ms
no pointer-down, native selection fence, menu, detail, queue keyboard focus, paging or active visual transaction
viewport.passiveEnvelope: observation only, not an input window

placement.firstRecommendation: once only: selected primary left-middle when unknown; explicit known fixed left Dock or Stage Manager may suggest right-middle
placement.legacyAbsolutePosition: preserve until explicit six-position choice; do not silently remap and claim no movement
placement.reconnect: explicit restore offer in current session
placement.fallbackExplicitChoice: new user preference supersedes old restore offer
placement.topology: re-enumerate per-screen frame/visibleFrame, support negative global coordinates and mixed scale

camera.expandedPlacement: independent screen clamp and collision check against all image/number/arrow inputs; inner neighboring column when necessary; never push queue
camera.sessionOrder: preserve existing fixed mode slots and moving cancel cover
camera.noSafeRailSpace: keep queue and menu capture entry; do not hide queue because camera does not fit

preview.placement: beyond inward extreme of all input islands + 12pt, within same screen
preview.fineView: explicit context menu / separate accessibility action; reuse history preview carrier
preview.zoom: fit, 100% logical, larger zoom and scroll
preview.budgets: retain source validation, cancellation, 64MB/16M display limits; never upscale 768px thumbnail as original

motion.reduceMotion: no spatial displacement; up to 80ms opacity
motion.parameterChange: cancel old decorative geometry without changing durable transfer authority

unchanged: screenshot entry mode order and explicit cancel
no smart thumbnails, OCR, AI summary or smart cropping introduced

verification.visualClaim: designed reconstruction; any retained native evidence is historical, not current native acceptance
